name: Thunder-Coil Basin
core_rationale: Eastern lightning-inductor basin of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's copper fingers grounded atmospheric storms into a ring of humming Leyden-jar towers.
local_conflict: Arc-charged copper automatons and storm-elementals surge along the inductor rails whenever the Steppe gales peak.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Unshielded cyan corona arcs bridge the northern Corona-Arc Cliff; Switch-Master Voltair requires the Faraday Grounding Rod before opening the northern gate.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider couriers say that flying within a league of Thunder-Coil Basin makes every brass button on your coat hum in three-part harmony.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Five colossal glass-and-copper Leyden-jar towers joined by harmless blue corona arcs above the eastern steppe.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sleeps beyond the Corona-Arc Cliff where Krono's lightning-rod fingers struck the eastern cliffside?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the eastern storm-inductor rim of Continent 02 and connects West to Bellows Hearth.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Colossal glass-and-copper Leyden-jar towers linked by singing blue corona arcs across the copper steppe.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m rubber-insulated copper catwalks, 0.60m capacitor test-benches, and 0.14m cog-steps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 grid connects Leyden Capacitor Causeway, Inductor Switchyard, and Faraday Dynamo Vault B1 across [32, 36] with construct and elemental families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-corona-arc-cliff at [1, 0] as a Mystery frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal on Inductor Switchyard.
